qualification: One pure Math.atanh implementation qualified independently; pending Date, strings, function reflection, Node and Wasm work excluded and preserved.

representation.operation: math_unary remains the single shared math dispatcher. Math.atanh uses odd symmetry and two cancellation-resistant log1p argument reductions instead of platform atanh. ToNumber and its observable effects remain at the existing native boundary.
representation.invariants: Return signed zero/NaN directly; magnitudes outside the named domain endpoint yield NaN; exact endpoints yield signed infinity. The reduction boundary and logarithmic scale have separate named meanings.
representation.scope: No new dependency, VM metadata, source/benchmark/fixture branch or duplicate semantic unit test. Numerical controls remain external diagnostics.

build.profile: release; correctness qualification, no Stage B performance claim

affected_test262.selection: Math and Number stages; staged Math only.

numeric_controls.reference: Python Decimal atanh=(ln((1+x)/(1-x)))/2 at max(96,96-adjusted(x)) decimal digits; exact binary float inputs, rounded to f64.
numeric_controls.limits: Sampled accuracy, not proof of correct rounding over all f64 inputs. Candidate maximum one ULP against Node and independent Decimal reference in both modes. Exact Node matches 988/1067; remaining values differ by one ULP. Baseline near the negative endpoint loses about 0.35 in absolute value.

node_semantic_controls.remaining_differences: The coercion control has the same single number-hint effect in Node and Quench, but its Math.atanh(0.5) string differs by one ULP. Retained both unmatched normal/generic observations; 14/16 exact matches in both revisions and zero losses.

limits: No pinned discovery, fixture, harness, exclusion, deadline or expectation changed. No full suite run or duplicated unit tests.
Complete Test262, the frozen implemented Node suite, Wasm and production single-VM cutover remain unqualified. Task 15, task 20 and Stage A remain open.
